S_rationale: Vow-fulfillment treated as plenary indulgence — external compliance terminating moral evaluation in this specific salvation-economy. A_rationale: Judicial procedures established (*Malleus Maleficarum* 1486, Carolina Code 1532, English Witchcraft Acts 1542/1563/1604). Defined infraction categories. C_rationale: Decentralized — local courts, varied procedure across European jurisdictions. Not under a single ecclesiastical or state authority. Federated/regional rather than monopolistic. Distinct from the Spanish Inquisition's monopoly.
E_rationale: Once formal proceedings began, accusation was often unappealable and lethal (hanging or burning). Confession-via-torture short-circuited normal evidentiary process. But geographic mobility was available — those threatened could flee to other jurisdictions, and many panics were spatially contained.
